observable: Coherent total Ez divided by paired empty-domain Ez at each point; positive excess loss is -20 log10(abs(ratio)).
scope: Two-dimensional cross-sections, infinite z extrusion and plane-wave illumination. Finite 20 mm leaf strip with physical 0.2 mm thickness; 20 mm square branch. No roughness/scattering model, no ground. These are reduced coupons, not the previous finite 3D point-source scenes.
comparison: Same deterministic illuminated/visible first-order edges for both formulations. DiffeRT native plane-wave diffraction matrix versus independent Sionna-equation evaluation in plane-wave limit, previously checked against native Sionna for spherical incidence. Common coherent GO field with physical-slab vacuum phase correction. No native path-discovery comparison.
limitations: Assumed nominal material parameters, no experimental validation.
First-order edge model omits internal edge waves, corner coupling, higher diffraction orders and refraction bending.
Leaf full-wave finite volume is approximated by a collapsed slab screen in ray models.
Wood transmission uses half-thickness per crossed face and repeats interfaces; not a continuous-volume solution.
Receiver points near surface intentionally probe limitations of asymptotic diffraction.
